name: planning-bpmn-modeling
description: Use when the user asks to model a business process as a BPMN diagram, BPMN 2.0 notation, AS-IS/TO-BE process maps, an approval workflow, DMN decision tables or Camunda process automation. Produces BPMN models and automation mapping. Not for system architecture diagrams (use create-tech-spec) or customer journeys (use product-customer-journey).
